ZE2 ModLoader Verification

1. Launch Zombie Estate 2.exe.
2. Confirm the game reaches the intro/main menu.
3. Confirm BepInEx\LogOutput.log contains:
   - Loading [ZE2 ModLoader 2.4.1]
   - ZE2 ModLoader parity features installed.
   - Integrated bridge methods resolved.
   - Legacy sprite merge initialization invoked.
4. Confirm the main menu includes Mods.
5. Copy one folder from ExampleMods into Mods and restart to test sample content.

If the game does not launch:
- Ensure Zombie Estate 2.exe.config exists beside Zombie Estate 2.exe.
- Ensure BepInEx\core\BepInEx.Preloader.Core.dll exists.
- Ensure BepInEx\core\BepInEx.Core.dll exists.
- Ensure BepInEx\core\0Harmony.dll exists.
- Ensure Zombie Estate 2.real.exe exists beside Zombie Estate 2.exe.
- Ensure BepInEx\plugins\ZE2.ModLoader.dll exists.
- Check BepInEx\LogOutput.log and Mods\ZE2ModLoader.log.
